title: Local agreement on pure wedges in normalized self-Tor coordinates
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], $n\in\mathbf N$, $B=i_*\mathcal O_Z$, $Q=i^*H^{-n}(B[0]\otimes^{\mathbf L}B[0])$ for the fixed derived tensor [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], $N=i^*\ker(i)$ [def-pc-module-pullback, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and $E=\bigwedge^n N$ [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. For each affine open $U$ of $Y$, put $A_U=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $I_U=i.\mathrm{ker}.\mathrm{ideal}(U)$, $O_U=i^{-1}U$, and let $T_U$ be associated-sheaf formation on $\operatorname{Spec}(A_U)$ followed by affine chart restriction, open pushforward, and tensor pullback by $i$. Let $c_U$ be the normalized comparison from the exterior conormal module to $\operatorname{Tor}^{A_U}_n(A_U/I_U,A_U/I_U)$ [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison]. There exist families of isomorphisms $s_U:E|_{O_U}\cong T_U(\operatorname{source}(c_U))|_{O_U}$ and $t_U:T_U(\operatorname{target}(c_U))|_{O_U}\cong Q|_{O_U}$. Define $\varphi_U=s_U\,T_U(c_U)\,t_U$ in composition order. For affine opens $V\subseteq U$, every open $W\subseteq O_V$, every tuple $a:\operatorname{Fin}(n)\to\Gamma(W,N)$, and every $x\in W$, there exists an open $W'\subseteq W$ containing $x$ such that the restrictions to $W'$ of $\varphi_U(W)(\bigwedge a)$ and $\varphi_V(W)(\bigwedge a)$ are equal. Here $\bigwedge a$ is the canonical section of the sheafification of the sectionwise exterior power. Equality on arbitrary sections and equality of the component maps are not asserted.

source.place: Tags 09PQ (resolution-independent products), 01R3 (1),(2), and 06YH; parent proof steps 1-3, restricted to local evaluation of a single pure wedge.

proof.text: Choose source and target chart coordinates whose conjugated comparisons agree on wedges of pullback-unit images of actual ideal sections on the smaller affine chart. This does not quantify over arbitrary coordinate families.

For the given W, tuple a and point x, the upstream conormal_wedge_mem_span_locally gives W′⊆W containing x and the span conclusion for the official exteriorPower/wedge construction. The exterior presheaves are equal by exteriorSheafPresheaf_eq_exteriorPower; their pure-wedge maps agree definitionally. Pair each presheaf with its pure-wedge maps in a dependent pair, and transport the entire restriction-and-span predicate along equality of these pairs. The private exterior_span_transport helper thereby gives exactly the original exteriorSheafSection conclusion, with the generator type supplied explicitly. No hypotheses change.

Naturality transports the generator equalities from i⁻¹V to W′. The proved exterior_over_eq_on_span helper extends equality by span induction: zero, addition and scalar multiplication follow from linearity. Naturality along W′→W identifies these equal values with the restrictions of the two original values on W. The same coordinates therefore satisfy the original local-wedge assertion.

proof_origin.place: Retain the ideal-generator and local-span route. Transport the upstream local-span theorem using equality of the exterior presheaves paired with their pure-wedge maps; all other steps are unchanged from the E3 proof.

theorem exists_local_wedge_selfTor_coordinates
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (n : ℕ) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let Q := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (-(n : ℤ))).obj
          (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B))
    let E := Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n
    let T := fun U : Y.affineOpens ↦
      tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
    let c := fun U : Y.affineOpens ↦
      selfTorConormalComparison (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
    ∃ (s : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≅ ((T U).obj _).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
      (t : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        ((T U).obj _).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≅ Q.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)),
      let φ := fun U ↦ (s U).hom ≫ ((T U).map (c U)).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≫ (t U).hom
      ∀ (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
        (W : Z.Opens) (hW : W ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
        (a : Fin n → ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules).val.obj (op W))
        (x : Z) (hx : x ∈ W),
        ∃ (W' : Z.Opens) (hW' : W' ≤ W), x ∈ W' ∧
          Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW').op
              ((φ U).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE
                (hW.trans ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map i.base).monotone h)))))
                (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n W a)) =
            Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW').op
              ((φ V).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hW)))
                (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection
                  ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n W a))
